assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other underlying cardiac arrhythmias.
ICD-10 code R55 is associated with the patient's presentation.
ICD-10 code I48.91 is associated with the patient's presentation.
ICD-10 code I49.9 is associated with the patient's presentation.
CPT code 93226 corresponds to the 48-hour Holter monitor.
The Holter monitor is used to correlate symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and guide further management.
The service is medically necessary for detecting intermittent arrhythmias not captured on routine monitoring.
